stories.label: Iran-US nuclear talks in Geneva
stories.summary: Talks began Feb 17 at Oman's embassy in Geneva. Trump involved 'indirectly.' Iran running Hormuz drills simultaneously. India seized sanctioned tankers. Graham warned 'intervention within weeks.' Highest-stakes diplomatic event of the week.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia Geneva peace talks
stories.summary: Ukraine recaptured 201 sq km in five days. Not selected this cycle (third consecutive rest needed) but talks expected tomorrow. Zelensky warns of new Russian strikes. Watch for outcome.

stories.label: Sudan compounding humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: Two days of drone strikes killed 60+ across Darfur and Kordofan — dramatic escalation. Fourth consecutive cycle of coverage. 11M+ displaced. AU declared world's worst crisis. Aerial campaign against civilian areas intensifying.

stories.label: European defence autonomy push
stories.summary: Macron visiting India with Rafale deal. Not selected this cycle — no new development beyond last cycle's Macron-India coverage. Munich rearmament push continuing.

stories.label: Global AI model race and governance
stories.summary: Ireland DPC opens formal probe into Grok deepfakes — first EU regulatory action targeting AI-generated deepfake content specifically. Pentagon-Anthropic rift continues. AI governance arc broadening from military ethics to consumer protection.

stories.label: Iran anti-regime protest movement
stories.summary: Massive diaspora rallies followed by chants inside Tehran. Not selected — folded into Iran nuclear talks context. Watch for Friday protests as talks outcome becomes clear.

stories.label: Trump Gaza Board of Peace
stories.summary: $5B+ pledged. Inaugural meeting Feb 19. No new developments — watch for meeting outcome.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Hezbollah disarmament
stories.summary: Lebanon set a four-month timeline for phase two of Hezbollah disarmament — most specific commitment since Nov 2024 ceasefire. Follows Israel's first post-truce strike that killed four. Credibility of timeline unclear.

stories.label: Israel ultra-Orthodox conscription crisis
stories.summary: Ultra-Orthodox mob attacked soldiers in Bnei Brak. Not selected — watch for political fallout.

stories.label: US military deployment to Nigeria
stories.summary: 100 US trainers at Bauchi Airfield. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle. Watch for developments on the ground.

stories.label: Cuba fuel crisis and US blockade
stories.summary: Spain routing aid through UN. Waste piling up as fuel blockade halts collection trucks. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle. Watch for further allied friction.

stories.label: Pentagon-Anthropic AI ethics clash
stories.summary: Pentagon may cut ties with Anthropic, label it supply chain risk. Not selected this cycle — covered last cycle. Watch for formal decision.

stories.label: Pakistan northwest insurgency attacks
stories.summary: At least 14 killed in multiple coordinated attacks near Afghan border. Intensifying insurgency amid simultaneous PTI political crisis. Pakistan facing dual security and political emergencies.

stories.label: Bangladesh new parliament and government
stories.summary: Tarique Rahman and new MPs sworn into parliament. Nobel laureate Yunus gives farewell address: 'no longer a submissive country.' Political transition completing after months of upheaval.

stories.label: Argentina general strike vs Milei reforms
stories.summary: CGT, Argentina's largest union federation, calls general strike against Milei's labour deregulation. First major organised union challenge to his economic shock therapy.

stories.label: Ireland DPC probe into Grok deepfakes
stories.summary: Ireland's Data Protection Commission opens formal probe into Grok generating deepfakes — first EU regulatory action specifically targeting AI-generated deepfake content under data protection law.

stories.label: Pakistan PTI sit-in over Imran Khan
stories.summary: PTI sit-in now in fifth day. KP cut off. Referenced in Pakistan attacks context but not independently selected. Watch for resolution or crackdown.

stories.label: Myanmar-ASEAN war crimes standoff
stories.summary: East Timor first ASEAN member to accuse Myanmar of war crimes. No new developments.

stories.label: Scientific brain drain to China
stories.summary: Brain Prize winner moved to Shenzhen. One-off event, no pattern emerging. Fading.

stories.label: Nepal post-uprising election
stories.summary: March 5 election approaching. No new developments this cycle.

stories.label: US Venezuela oil blockade enforcement
stories.summary: US boarded tanker enforcing Venezuela blockade. No new incidents — fading.

stories.label: Navalny death European investigation
stories.summary: Five European countries accused Russia of killing Navalny with toxin. No new developments — fading.

stories.label: Ethiopia revokes Reuters accreditation
stories.summary: Ethiopia revoked Reuters journalists' accreditation following an investigative report. Not selected this cycle but worth tracking — press freedom story in Africa.
